integrity: The proof starts from the published exact vertex model, identifies Euclidean squared distance with support Hamming distance, solves the resulting two-matching optimization by an explicit three-state max-plus dynamic program, and derives the zero-vertex eccentricity independently. The bundled exhaustive enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the standard type-A shard-polytope coordinate realization and ordinary Euclidean diameter. It does not address type-B shard polytopes, affine-invariant metrics, one-skeleton graph diameter, or arbitrary Minkowski sums of shard polytopes. A residual literature risk remains for an equivalent statement under the series-parallel matroid interpretation.
title: A run-length formula for the Euclidean diameter of every shard polytope
